# Gas and Oil Recruitment

> British international recruiter (Abarrane Limited; public face Peter Smith) placing Western senior oil & gas, mining and EPCM people into Saudi Arabia — especially Riyadh — and serving existing GCC markets from one brand hub. High-ticket, scarce roles only. Staging site is noindex until the owner authorises go-live.

## Positioning
Gas and Oil Recruitment is a specialist energy desk, not a volume Gulf job board and not a generic “oil and gas recruitment agency Saudi Arabia” page. We send Western engineers and senior personnel into the Gulf one-by-one or in bulk, contract or permanent, where the role is scarce and quota allows. We do not promise to bypass Saudization. Engineering localisation of 30% (SCE accreditation; SAR 8,000 floor) has been in force since 30 June 2026.

Primary commercial focus: drilling and wells leadership into the Kingdom (superintendent, well-site, completions leads) — vacancy and crewing intent, not junior drilling-engineer volume already owned by large panels.

Secondary: senior oil & gas project / EPC leadership (permanent-led, tightly scoped — not generic executive search); mining engineer and EPCM leadership against real Ma'aden-ecosystem demand; permanent commissioning and start-up only (contract day-rate commissioning is the wrong model for KSA). Renewables are held for a later phase.

British / UK / London language is trust copy for Western-HQ buyers (oil and gas recruitment agency; mining recruitment agency; energy executive search). The searchable KSA proxy for that British identity is “international” recruitment.

## Service area (no city clone pages)
Saudi Arabia (Riyadh and the Kingdom) is the target market. We also place into Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Bahrain and Qatar from this same hub.
